Proposition
[Dimension of the Tangent Space]

↗ prop:3-6 ↗ prop:3-9

1. ch3:3.10If $M$ is a smooth $n$-manifold, then $\dim T_pM=n$ for every $p\in M$.

Proof

\sketch For a chart $\varphi :U\to \widehat U\subseteq \mathbb {R}^n$ containing $p$, Propositions 2 and 4 give

\[ T_pM\cong T_pU\cong T_{\varphi (p)}\widehat U \cong T_{\varphi (p)}\mathbb {R}^n. \]

The last space has dimension $n$.
